notes.title: "Silent Legend" Epic Update Announcement
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players,
"Silent Legend" unveils an [b]epic update[/b]! This version focuses on three core elements: [b]hardcore fairness, exclusive exploration, and ultra-fast attack speed[/b], creating a legendary world for all players to enjoy! Whether you're an office worker, a casual gamer, or a budget-conscious warrior, you can experience the thrill of [b]common mobs dropping ultimate gear and casual players dominating whales[/b]![/p][p][b]Highlighted Features[/b][/p][p][b]1. Exclusive Identification System[/b][/p][list][*][p]All equipment randomly rolls [b]11 legendary affixes[/b]: Strength | Refinement | Demon Slaying | Bloodlust | Fortune | Ironclad | Fury | Severance | Savagery | Finesse | Swiftness![/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloodlust affix is a must-have[/b]! Equip 3-7 for maximum lifesteal and effortless tanking![/p][/*][*][p]Total affix count unlocks hidden divine powers, stacking skill buffs for explosive stat growth![/p][/*][/list][p][b]2. Instant Power Surge[/b][/p][list][*][p]Follow main quests to blaze through continental lore and claim [b]free rewards[/b] from the top menu![/p][/*][*][p][b]7-Day Power-Up Quests[/b] grant Spirit Essence and Feather Coins for a head start![/p][/*][*][p][b]Slicing System[/b]: Blistering attack speed + fixed damage cuts through mobs like butter![/p][/*][*][p][b]Aura System[/b]: Mid-to-late game爆发 (breakout) with boosted damage, drop rates, and elemental mastery![/p][/*][/list][p][b]3. Hardcore Fairness Mechanics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minimal gap between whales and f2p players! All gear is farmable—even common mobs drop ultimate loot![/p][/*][*][p]Casual player bonus: Fate Divination in the Second Continent offers a chance at [b]free top-tier membership[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p][b]4. New Maps & Bosses[/b]
[b]Second Continent - Bloody Caverns[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unlock hidden maps essential for achievement titles![/p][/*][*][p]Daily bounty quests reward massive currency—farm and earn simultaneously![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Third Continent - Dragonflame Realm[/b][/p][list][*][p]Core exclusive [b]"Dragon's Shockwave"[/b] (upgraded Tear Axe): Rare but sells for a fortune—first casual to loot it strikes gold![/p][/*][*][p][b]Insect Nest[/b] drops [b]Shadowrend Claw[/b], a percentage-based slicing bracelet that shreds even white bosses![/p][/*][*][p]Legendary bosses like [b]Gonggong, Zhurong, and Poseidon[/b] debut with game-breaking exclusive gear![/p][/*][/list][p][b]5. Divine Gear Overhaul[/b]
[b]Resistance Gear[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Luo River Night Demon Pendant[/b] (Freeze Immunity): Drops from Luo River mobs—counters third-continent boss freezes![/p][/*][*][p][b]Underworld Guardian's Mantle[/b] (Paralysis Immunity): Drops from Ghost Market mobs—PvP/PvE essential![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Trinity Force Synthesis[/b][/p][list][*][p]Combine [b]Soulforce (Dragonflame) + Cosmic Force (Benevolence Realm) + Spiritforce (Inferno Realm)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Forged [b]Trinity Force[/b] grants massive fixed slicing damage and attack power per piece![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Spirit King Palace Titles[/b][/p][list][*][p]Third-continent hidden titles with godlike stats—miss them, regret forever![/p][/*][/list][p][b]6. Pacing Refinements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Non-stop action: Leveling, hidden lore, title unlocks, and secret maps seamlessly intertwine![/p][/*][*][p]Follow the [b]Phantom Lotus Questline[/b] to go from novice to pro in no time![/p][/*][*][p]Endgame freedom: Endless mysteries await your exploration![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Important Notes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Report bugs or suggestions via customer support for [b]generous rewards[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]Casual players—race for [b]first-kill rights on third-continent white bosses[/b] for massive profits![/p][/*][/olist][p][b]"Silent Legend" Operations Team[/b]
[b]Legendary hardcore fairness awaits—let skill and strategy reign supreme![/b]
[b]Brothers, assemble—this time, conquer with affixes and mastery![/b][/p]
